parts.style: calm, reverent, reading scripture aloud slowly
parts.text: The Lord is my shepherd; <short pause> I shall not want. <short pause> Psalm twenty-three, verse one.

Lord, You are my shepherd. <short pause> You know what I need before I ask, and You provide for me. <short pause> Tonight I rest in Your care, trusting that under Your watch I lack nothing. <short pause> I belong to You. <short pause> Amen.
